message.content: Which of our stateful object classes have instances that currently hold stored data?

content.text:
I can't name which classes hold stored data because both calls were dry runs and returned no data. To get the answer, send `GET /accounts/demo/workers/durable_objects/namespaces` to list each namespace with its `class` and `id`. Then, for each namespace, send `GET .../namespaces/{id}/objects?limit=1000` and page through with `cursor`. A class has stored data if any of its objects has `hasStoredData: true`.

I built the request that lists the account's Durable Object namespaces and the per-namespace object listing, using `demo-namespace-id` as a placeholder ID. Neither request was sent, so I have no namespaces or objects to report.
